trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all other 54 trophies to unlock the platinum. This is the final trophy you'll get after completing the story, all side content, collectibles, and challenges. No online component required.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in Progress > Stats. Requires all main missions, stranger strands, 70/80 challenges, all bank vaults, gang operations, drone races, shooting ranges, vehicle scans (200), animal studies (100), and collectibles. Longest trophy at ~100 hours post-story (GTABase roadmap).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 5's final mission. Story-related, cannot be missed if you finish the game. The gold tier reflects it being the narrative climax.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission "Gone Fishing" in Chapter 1. This is the very first mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish all Chapter 1 missions. Story progression trophy, unmissable. Chapter 1 introduces Lucia and Jason in Leonida.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all Chapter 2 missions. Story progression, unmissable. The asterisks in the name are intentional per PlayStation's official listing.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish all Chapter 3 missions. Story progression, unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish all Chapter 4 missions. Story progression, unmissable.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Breakfast Run" in Chapter 1. Part of the main story path, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "The Cartel Heist". Main story mission, unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Child's Play". Main story mission, unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Headliners". Main story mission, unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "VCIA Takedown". Main story mission, unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission "Operation Savage Glory". Main story mission, unmissable.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand. Stranger missions appear as optional content during the story; complete them when available. Andy's strand concludes with his final mission (GTABase).

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand. Available during the story; don't skip stranger missions when they appear (GTABase).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand. Part of the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks silver trophy (GTABase).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand. One of several character quest lines that unlock during story progression (GTABase).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand. Character quest lines are only offered for a limited window; do them when they appear (GTABase).

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, plus 2 others). Strands unlock during story; play them when available. Not required for 100% but needed for this silver (GTABase).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret's stranger mission involving hunting a unique animal. Part of Bret's strand which also ties to collectible card sets (Don't Touch My Deck). Available during story (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Complete this story-related mission at the VCIA facility. Part of the main narrative path, unmissable if you follow the story (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks during a mission. The description "Kinda hot in these Rhinos" suggests a specific story moment involving tanks. Unmissable story trophy (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit Ocean Beach and have a cocktail at a specific location. Likely a story beat or stranger mission moment. Can be done in free roam after story if missed (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Destroy a vehicle showroom in a specific way during a mission. "Classic style" references GTA Vice City's mall scene. Story mission, unmissable (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. Likely a story mission activity or stranger mission. Can be replayed in free roam (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Complete a partnership-related activity with your co-protagonist. Vague description suggests a story moment with both characters. Unmissable if story is completed (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make narrative choices during the story. PSN tracks a count to 500 for this trophy. Choices appear throughout the campaign; simply play the story (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something. Likely a mission retry or specific challenge. Will come naturally during playthrough (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness a strange/unexplained event. GTA games often have Easter eggs or weird encounters. Likely tied to a specific location or mission (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down an enemy with a melee attack while driving by. Can be done in free roam with any vehicle. Easy to get naturally or cleanup post-story (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform 250 unique stunt jumps across Leonida. Stunt locations are marked on the map. Can be done anytime in free roam. Use a fast bike or car for best control (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all 9 activity types once each: races, drone races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting, and challenges. Comes naturally during 100% run (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has bronze/silver/gold tiers. Practice each to learn patterns. Can be done post-story in free roam (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations across Leonida. Races unlock as you explore. Drone controls take practice; retry until first place. Free roam accessible (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct race events (street, off-road, water, etc.). Races appear on map. Can repeat same race type at different locations. Do in free roam after story (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Defeat Cal (a character) in a fishing contest. Fishing mechanics involve timing and lure selection. Challenge appears during story or as side content (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one of the in-game arcade cabinets. Arcades are found in bars, malls, and entertainment venues. Play until credits roll (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: Chapter 1 has a Lucia meditation at Jason's house after "Down to Earth" that may not be accessible later (PowerPyx/GTABase). Do all Chapter 1 meditations before progressing.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect and complete 3 full sets of Bret's Target Deck cards. Cards are found across Leonida; use the WAiNK app to track. Part of 100% completion checklist (GTABase).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan/check-in at 100 locations. 200 scans needed for 100% completion. Scan vehicles, landmarks, and points of interest as you explore (GTABase).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the 80 total challenges. Challenges include combat, driving, flying, and survival tasks. 70 needed for 100% completion. Track in Progress menu (GTABase).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach 4-star wanted level while with your co-protagonist, then escape together. Can be done in free roam by causing chaos. Co-op escape mechanics required (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 stores consecutively with your partner while maintaining wanted level. Requires coordination; do in free roam. Shops are marked on map (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find and enter 100 unique vehicles. 200 needed for 100% completion. Drive/ride each vehicle type once. Use WAiNK app to track discovered vehicles (GTABase).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill 5 enemies during one Combat Focus (slow-mo) activation. Build focus meter, then trigger in a dense combat encounter. Easy in gang operations or high wanted levels (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Stealth-rob a jewelry store: avoid cameras, guards, and alarms. Use silenced weapons, distractions, and timing. Jewelry stores marked on map. Can retry if detected (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete 5 bank vault heists and escape successfully. Vaults are major side activities with prep, execution, and escape phases. Part of 100% completion (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hijack and rob an armored truck, then lose the cops. Armored trucks patrol roads randomly. Ram or block them, grab cash, escape. Classic GTA gameplay (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal all 52 map areas/regions of Leonida. Drive, fly, and boat to every corner. Fog of war clears as you travel. Comes naturally during 100% run (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation (drug lab, chop shop, etc.) for each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations are marked on map after intel. Required for 100% completion (GTABase).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250k in marked bills via contact missions. Marked bills come from robberies and heists. Contact missions unlock as you progress. Grind in free roam (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100k total at shops (clothing, weapons, vehicles, properties, etc.). Money accumulates naturally. Buy properties, customizations, and supplies to hit this (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages store vehicles and serve as save points. Expensive but affordable post-story. Marked on map (GTA6 Field Guide).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros delivery app. Steal/buy vehicles, then register them via the app menu. Part of vehicle collection for 100% (GTA6 Field Guide).
